hints.title: Capitalizing Initial Character
hints.text: Extract the first character and convert it to uppercase using standard string functions.

hints.title: Lowercasing Trailing Characters
hints.text: extract the substring from index 2 to the end and convert it to lowercase.

hints.title: Concatenating and Ordering
hints.text: concatenate the uppercase initial and lowercase remainder with concat and order the final result by user_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT user_id, CONCAT(UPPER(SUBSTRING(name, 1, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(name, 2))) AS name
FROM Users
ORDER BY user_id;
```

complexity.notes: Performs scalar string manipulation in O(N) followed by O(N log N) index ordering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual string looping or external formatting scripts cannot run directly inside a relational engine query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Built-in string functions process each row in single-pass linear time with negligible memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should know UPPER, LOWER, SUBSTRING, and CONCAT functions in standard SQL.
